Name: GitHub Markdown to Nexusmods BBCode converter
Author: miome
Description:
[b]Convert your GitHub documentation to a NexusMods-compabible format in one easy step!
[/b]
Go to [url=https://miome.github.io/githubmd-to-nexusmodsbbcode/]my Github.IO page[/url]﻿, and copy-paste your Github markdown to receive your NexusMods-friendly BBCode.  

Want to make your conversions offline? Download the file, open it in a webbrowser, and use it right there on your own computer.

Happy modding!

Based on [url=https://github.com/Legend-of-iPhoenix/markdown-bbcode-html]markdown-bbcode-html[/url] by legend-of-phoenix
